name: The Bank of Saga Ltd.
summary: The Bank of Saga Ltd. provides various banking products and services in Japan. The company offers web account, fixed term deposits, foreign currency deposits, and investment trusts; home, auto, educational, card, easy, agriculture, syndicated loans, and other loans for corporate and sole proprietor customers; medical, nursing care, personal pension, single payment, and internet insurance; and internet banking.
